summary_zh: 为 AI 编程助手保存跨会话记忆，把之前的工作上下文带到下一次对话。
audience_zh: 希望在 Claude Code、Codex 等工具中持续保留项目上下文的用户。

evidence.quote: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
